responsibility: Contains out-of-line implementations for general Rust AST support that are shared across node families: stringification helpers (`as_string` routines), delimiter/attribute formatting utilities, deep-copy support for common structures, `accept_vis` methods that connect nodes to `ASTVisitor`, and small AST-level conversions such as `GenericArg` disambiguation. This is the module’s central implementation unit for cross-cutting AST mechanics rather than for any one syntax category.
same_name_distinction: Provides the out-of-line implementation side of the core AST definitions from rust-ast.h: shared `as_string` helpers, attribute/delimiter utilities, `accept_vis` dispatch for many node classes, and small conversions such as `GenericArg` disambiguation. Unlike the header, this `.cc` is the common AST mechanics implementation unit, not the place where the foundational node types are declared.
